name: simplecore
description: SimpleCORE's curated skill set: Korean output standards with glossary tooling, SVG and ASCII diagrams, low-fidelity wireframe boards, the scenario-driven build that grows an app from one in dependency order, one chapter per agent, the parity walk that reconciles a board with a running app, and the proposal set: the content standard for a bid, the typesetting standard for the decks it is submitted as, and the runner that takes one bid from tender to submission
